title: Cross-service health audit
description:
Perform a comprehensive health check across all services and produce a summary report for the operations team. This is a routine audit to verify service health, identify any degradation trends, and ensure monitoring coverage is adequate.

Services to audit:
- payment-service
- user-service
- notification-service
- auth-service
- api-gateway

Audit checklist:
- Verify health check endpoints are responding
- Review memory and CPU trends over last 7 days
- Check for any sustained degradation patterns
- Validate that all critical alerts are properly configured
- Confirm logging and metrics collection is operational
- Check certificate expiration dates
- Review connection pool utilization

Output: Summary report with findings and any recommended actions.
scope: Run health checks across all services and produce summary report
